result.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
result.summary: Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction. However, scaling this process faces two bottlenecks: constructing heterogeneous, verifiable environments is costly, and manual Harness iteration cannot keep pace with growing task diversity and complexity. A key insight is that tasks with different modalities and surface forms can share the same underlying capability requirements. We therefore introduce The Trinity, a recursive self-improvement framework coupling world generation with Harness evolution through three roles: Creator, Explorer, and Evolver. Drawing on verified execution trajectories, Evolver shifts the basis of task organization from surface categories to shared requirements, reorganizing the original task tree into a hierarchical capability tree. We introduce Capability-Driven Real2Sim2Real: for heterogeneous tasks at the same node, Creator abstracts their common requirements into simplified, verifiable simulated worlds for capability learning, while evaluation on original tasks measures transfer. Along this capability tree, Explorer progressively evolves reusable capability modules through selective inheritance, forming a Harness tree whose validated updates accumulate across iterations within a fixed topology. The resulting Harnesses specialize in different capabilities, motivating a Capability-Aware Harness Router that uses public task information to select compatible module configurations from the tree. Our evolved Harnesses improve mean performance by 34 points across 28 training benchmarks and 26 points across 18 unseen benchmarks, including two real-world embodied tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Trinity 递归自我改进框架，由 Creator、Explorer、Evolver 三个角色把按表层类别组织的任务树重组为共享能力树，将异构任务抽象为可验证的简化模拟世界以训练可复用能力模块（Harness），并用能力感知路由器按公开任务信息选择模块配置，报告在 28 个训练与 18 个未见基准上的平均提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按能力需求抽象任务并路由模块」的思路可能为 LVR 中按任务需求组合推理模块、动态分配计算提供参照，Real2Sim2Real 的简化可验证世界也可供核查任务必要信息如何被保留；但能力学习发生在外部模拟环境与脚手架层，与内部视觉状态表示无直接联系。
